notes: Most step-4 tests carry explicit tags such as US2-1, US1-5, FR-004, DM-… or SC-006 that lead to specific acceptance scenarios in spec.md. acceptance-matrix.json maps every FR to named tests, and the WP task files name the source files under test, so the code can be found without searching the repo. Some tests have no tag or only an 'edge case' comment (for example test_watch_rejects_invalid_actor_before_announcing and test_actor_id_is_everything_after_the_first_colon). The integration tests do not name the code they exercise, and every matrix entry has placeholder 'TODO' notes and boilerplate descriptions.
